_about: The Phase 1 in-prose links (configs/link-changes/phase1-links-2026-09-22.json + 5 collection descriptions) were added in English only; the five other locales served the text without them (found by scripts/link-audit.py 2026-09-22). Each entry: the English paragraph as live (`old`), the English paragraph to publish (`en` — six anchors rewritten for anchor variety and head-term matches: Argireline had zero exact-match anchors site-wide), and the paragraph in each locale, appended to that locale's existing translation. Applied by scripts/add-translated-links.py.
